records.summary: Accepted .ok source remains authoritative for named parts, units, relationships, physical declarations and source identity; destination tools own their runtime behavior.
records.scope: Product direction and semantic-authoring boundary

records.summary: Ownership, transform placement, following, physical connection and motion authority are distinct; preserve single matter accounting and existing adopted meanings.
records.scope: Language and semantic preservation

records.summary: C252 prioritizes comparative localized-authoring evidence before further receiver expansion. A public qualification family does not establish a general authoring advantage.
records.scope: Current investment priority and comparative claims

records.summary: C261 extracts raw GLB hinge fields and exact pointers only. Source/program mapping remains untrusted metadata; a reader pass does not verify source agreement, accepted revisions or execution authority.
records.scope: Finite hinge observation trust boundary

records.summary: Independent source hinge observation, source/artifact comparison and historical byte admission remain unfinished. Resume their selected bounded step under unchanged C260 only when authorized current work selects it.
records.scope: Queued product work; no new scientific completion claim

records.summary: Fresh local checks are the default under the no-payment policy. Hosted jobs remain manual-only and default-false; configured or blocked CI is not executed evidence.
records.scope: Verification and execution-provider policy

records.summary: Main is the current development baseline. A reviewed bounded increment can be integrated without declaring its entire feature released; verify resulting main and retain branch history before cleanup.
records.scope: Integration, release claims and branch lifecycle

records.summary: After an uncertain write or interrupted session, reconcile actual refs, files and ownership before retrying. A timeout or lease expiry does not establish write failure or that the previous worker stopped.
records.scope: Recovery and concurrent work

records.summary: Current-labeled navigation can retain completed handoff actions. Reconcile those pointers against live task state during a fresh-start review while preserving historical records.
records.scope: Browser-chat recovery and current documentation navigation; does not invalidate historical observations.

records.summary: Browser development and recovery require a verified saved session ZIP in addition to GitHub progress. Save early recoverable checkpoints; integrated work with outstanding delivery is incomplete.
records.scope: Browser workflow and online session handoffs; C262 remains the separate unchanged historical archive, not replaced by a full offline restoration claim.

records.summary: C265 implements the bounded independent source hinge interface. Complete source/artifact association and historical endpoint admission remain separate unfinished interfaces under unchanged C260; source-site poses remain unevaluated.
records.scope: Finite hinge observation progress and remaining qualification; no broader source, physical, destination or comparative claim.

records.summary: C266 independently binds retained source/program/object provenance. Agreement between repeated artifact maps is insufficient: each map must match complete source-derived declarations, identities and full keyed-entry spans. Hinge-field/set/endpoint comparison remains separate.
records.scope: Finite C266 input-association prerequisite; excludes omitted module/scene/collection fields, historical admission, site poses and wider qualification.

records.summary: Repeated recovery should resume the first unmet gate from exact preserved evidence. Check receipt-listed ignored logs before publication; reuse unchanged candidate results after identity audit, then perform required actual-main checks. Freeze the session ZIP once and record its save externally.
records.scope: Browser recovery efficiency and evidence retention; no guaranteed host limit prevention or reduced verification obligations.

records.summary: A rebound source site-key change can preserve agreement when its lexical endpoint path is unchanged, because the finite GLB profile has no direct site ID. C267 must expose the changed source-derived site identity without inventing a directly measured artifact ID.
records.scope: C260/C267 finite declaration comparison; no blanket provenance, historical admission, pose, validity or execution claim.

records.summary: For the finite C265 endpoint observer, exact authored SiteRef parameter type plus legal member access identifies an unsupported form without evaluating its value. The refusal must preserve identities/reason through binding and comparison; declaration classification does not establish whole-source validity.
records.scope: C270 finite classification correction and exact tested refusal propagation only; no added successful support, initializer validation or broader qualification

records.summary: C271 established the exact loader's source correspondence through official package-member equality and checksum-bound source/patch review. Its external suffix-completeness acceptance did not admit actual inputs: the unchanged reader next refused libc's excluded dynamic tags. Preserve the first failed predicate; later raw flags are not its observed cause.
records.scope: C271 P15's bound amd64 loader and libc under unchanged reader SHA256 a8274d56076562a91d26b3cdd2f614fce6fd509733e4939b225dff2ddca09db4. No signature/reproduced-build proof, general source-completeness rule, H0/H1 qualification, operational-plan approval or permission to loosen admitted tags.

records.summary: Keep current task state in the session checkpoint, not in an agent's private memory. The Claude application loads private memory into every later session of the project, also in linked worktrees; a note saved shortly before the fresh-session demonstration reached that session and the run could not count.
records.scope: Local Claude sessions and demonstrations of resumption from the repository; observed once, with one application version.

records.summary: Before a plan gives an existing test file to a worker, search the test modules for runtime freezes of companion bytes. C271-P29's required-images controls authenticate 24 inherited companions when they load; C271-P33's sanctioned change to one of them, tests/test_current_host_readback_driver.py, made that whole frozen control set refuse to load. Keep a frozen companion's bytes and put new tests in a new module.
records.scope: Frozen control sets that authenticate companion files when they load; observed once, in C271's gate MI (decision D-18).

records.summary: A facade that dispatches between contract versions must bind the version once per transaction, at its start, rather than decide it again at every call from mutable input. C271-P33's first facade chose the version per call from the configuration's current bytes, so a configuration changed between a cohort's setup and its accounting sent the 0.2.0 cohort to the 0.1.0 accounting, which wrote an unlabelled 0.1.0 record; the independent review found it, and D-20 binds the version at setup.
records.scope: Versioned facades of the current-host readback provider; observed once, in C271's gate MI. A later contract version that keeps the facade pattern inherits the rule.

records.summary: On macOS, CPython's platform.platform() starts uname -p and file -b on its first call in a process and caches the answer. A control that counts every process start of code that calls it depends on test order unless it isolates this metadata leaf, as the project's driver tests do; C271-P33's MC21 driver cases failed for this reason only when they ran first.
records.scope: CPython 3.12.13 on macOS 26.6.2 arm64 (decision D-19); the project's earlier Linux driver tests stubbed the same call because it started uname (commit 113e1b85).

records.summary: On Darwin, killpg(pgid, 0) answers EPERM while the members of a process group have exited but are not yet reaped, and ESRCH after reaping. A supervisor that treats only ESRCH as absence must count EPERM as present; ontokin.current-host-readback/0.2.0 does so since P33-AMENDMENT-001.
records.scope: macOS 26.6.2 (25G83) arm64, one host; the direct probe and control MC37 observed it. Other systems are not covered.

records.summary: When a unittest assertion on a mocked subprocess.Popen fails, its message lists the recorded calls with their env argument, which prints the parent process environment, private values included. Redact such logs before keeping them, and never publish raw test output.
records.scope: Tests that assert on a mocked Popen called with an env argument, under CPython 3.12's unittest.mock; observed in C271's gate MI, where two 0.1.0 driver tests fail by design.

records.summary: To give a qualification venv exactly its pinned distributions and no pip, install the hash-locked wheels with the base interpreter installation's pip through --python, offline, with --no-deps, --only-binary=:all:, --require-hashes, --no-compile and no bytecode, under a declared environment. The setup tool installs through the venv's own pip, which would remain in site-packages, and M0's exact package rule refuses it; the doctor then reports pip check as not checked, by design.
records.scope: CPython 3.12.13 with pip 26.0 on macOS arm64, for the 0.2.0 readback contract's .venv; observed once, in C271's gate MP.

records.summary: The 0.2.0 preparer writes its report on a dry run too, and every run needs an absent report path, so a dry run and its application need two frozen plan variants that differ only in report.
records.scope: tools/prepare_current_host_readback.py, its install/0.2.0 route; observed in C271's gate MP.

records.summary: When exact plans live outside Git, pass their reviewed digests to the applying tool as recorded values. A digest recomputed from the plan file at run time makes the frozen-digest check vacuous, because it can never fail.
records.scope: The preparer's --plan-sha256 and any check of a frozen input by digest; found by the independent plan review of C271's gate MP (P-07).

records.summary: A frozen time limit must be one the actual executor can carry out. Claude Code's shell tool runs each command without a terminal (no Ctrl-C), blocks the Director in foreground mode and ends a foreground command at its own timeout of at most 600 s. So launch each frozen command alone in background mode with no tool timeout, and start a frozen bound timer beside it that only waits for the command's exit file. At the bound, record the outcome UNKNOWN, probe the recorded starts, and stop only processes whose identity is established; never signal the command, the tool's task or its group.
records.scope: Claude Code's shell tool in the desktop app on macOS, for a Director who runs frozen commands; found by freeze review 001 of C271's gate MH (FR-01) and used for all 72 commands of S7, none of which overran.

records.summary: A capture tool that exits 0 whatever it records (here capture_probe.py's listing and probe) checks nothing by itself. Each of its predicates must be evaluated by a frozen step before the next start, for example by appending them to the main command's frozen expectations, which the checker step evaluates after the listing and the probe.
records.scope: The FAILURE-CAPTURE readback and process probe of C271's gate MH; found by freeze review 001 (FR-02).

records.summary: The repository's .gitignore matches *.log and ENV/, and on macOS's case-insensitive file system ENV/ also matches env/. Portable evidence copies with those names stay untracked unless they are added with git add -f, as earlier evidence logs were. Check git status --ignored after writing copies.
records.scope: Committing evidence records on the owner's macOS clone; observed in C271's gate MH, where 29 portable copies were ignored.

records.summary: Workers' privacy-scan scripts often hard-code the very terms they search for, such as installed applications, process names or the package manager. Keep such scripts and raw outputs beside the clone, recorded by digest, and commit only labelled reports and scripts that derive their terms at run time. A plain text search misses split literals, so also search each Python file's joined string constants.
records.scope: Path-portable copies of worker records in a public repository; observed in C271's gate MH, where three such scripts were kept local.

records.summary: Before a qualifying run of tools/check_local.py is frozen, check by reading that every path tracked at the candidate reaches the driver's isolated workspace, or that the provider's derived source check admits its absence. The driver copies only SOURCE_DIRS and ROOT_FILES while read-tree gives the workspace's index the whole tree, so a tracked path outside that set shows as deleted, and the 0.2.0 provider refuses every status line that is not a generated example. Main's own summaries record the workspace's tracked status (workspace_git/tracked_worktree_status), which shows such paths.
records.scope: tools/check_local.py and prototypes/static_tray_v01/current_host_readback_v02.py at C271's commit B (4ca78142), where seven tracked .claude/ entries made R1's preparation refuse; found by gate MR's freeze review 001 (FZ-01) by reading, before any run.
